title: Quality eval grades
description: Hand grades of search results and the independent recall baseline, stored at docs/evidence/quality/grades.json. See eval/README.md for how each field is judged.

url.description: retailer.url from the saved response, verbatim

local_exists.description: Local results only: the shop exists at the listed address. 'no' means confirmed not there (e.g. a map check finds no such business, or another business now occupies the address), not merely a site that would not load or resolve; a site that fails to load with no other evidence either way is 'unknown', not 'no'. 'unknown' also covers conflicting evidence (e.g. a dead site but a current listing)

badges_sourced.description: Every certification badge's source link supports it; n/a when there are none

page_access.description: What a person in a real browser got

store_breadth.description: The grader's own judgment of the shop's product breadth, not the model's

url.description: Null only for a local shop with no website

also_urls.description: Other domains the same business uses, e.g. one that redirects to url; a result on any of them counts as found

confirmed.description: Opened in a real browser and seen to sell the product

miss_reason.description: Null when the site returned this retailer; set by the grader when it did not

chain.description: 10 or more US stores under one name; Ace Hardware and other dealer-owned chains count as the chain (docs/quality.md:17, operator Q1). Optional so older baseline files stay valid; absent means not yet labelled, not 'independent'

chain_source.description: The store-count page, locator or listing the chain label rests on
